moved.sentence: Types, methods, properties, public fields, constants, namespaces MUST use `PascalCase`

judged.note: The MUST for PascalCase on types, methods, properties, public fields, constants and namespaces is kept verbatim with every symbol kind.

moved.sentence: Parameters and local variables MUST use `camelCase`

judged.note: The MUST for camelCase on parameters and local variables is kept verbatim.

moved.sentence: Private instance fields MUST use `_camelCase` (underscore prefix)

judged.note: The MUST for _camelCase with underscore prefix on private instance fields is kept verbatim.
The unkeyed I-prefix convention for interfaces is kept at SHOULD with the IDisposable example.

moved.sentence: Async methods MUST have the `Async` suffix (e.g., `SaveAsync`)

judged.note: The MUST for the Async suffix on async methods is kept verbatim with the SaveAsync example.
The MUST for PascalCase constants, not SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, is kept verbatim.

moved.sentence: Use `var` when the type is apparent from the right side of the assignment

judged.note: Using var when the type is apparent from the right side of the assignment is kept at SHOULD with its condition.
